info.title: session-view
info.summary: Serves the read models of the UI (`ui/agenticspec.ui.yaml`) over HTTP: the session list, one session, its agents and its events, and publishes their changes for a live page.
info.description:
The HTTP surface of `session-view`, one of the components of `agenticspec` v1.

Every path here is one semantic command, so the method is always POST and the path is the command's wire name under its domain's: a command is not a resource, and this document does not invent one. A status code is the outcome the specification declares — 202 for a branch that was taken, 422 for a refusal the input decides, 502 for a refusal decided outside the request — and the `outcome` property of every response body names the branch. This component publishes `AgentUpdated`, `EventAppended` and `SessionUpdated` to consumers through the event transport; an event a branch emits that is not among them stays inside the component. The `published` property of every response body lists every event its branch emitted, in the order it emits them, published or not.

The specification declares who may invoke what (`x-ess-may-invoke` on each operation), so every command is sent as a declared actor. How a request proves which actor it is belongs to the realization, which authenticates it and hands the surface the caller; nothing in the request itself names one. The grant is checked before the command runs, and a request authenticated as no actor, or as one without the grant, is answered 403 with one standard refusal, the same for every command: `{"refused": "not granted", "actor": <name or null>}`. A 403 a declared branch answers carries `outcome` and the declared `error` instead, so a client tells the two apart by the members present. A command no declared actor may invoke is refused to every caller. A view an actor's grant names is read-checked the same way (`x-ess-may-read` on its operation): a request authenticated as no actor, or as one the grant does not name, is answered 403 with the same standard refusal before the view is read. A view no grant names is open, and any caller may read what it publishes.

This component declares `reached_by: network`, so its callers are not deployed with it and this contract is the surface they reach it through. That declaration is also why the views its domains declare have paths here: a GET under `views` per projection, answering every row it holds. There is no page size, no cursor, no ordering and no filter parameter, because the specification states none — a view's filter is part of the projection, not of the request. A view that declares `params:` is the exception: each is a query parameter, described on its operation, and a view that declares `paging:` takes its page and size there.

200.description: Every row of `agenticspec.view.AgentTurns`, a projection of `agenticspec.view.EventRow`. Contains the instances where `(session_id == param.session_id and agent == param.agent and kind == model_turn)` holds. Eventually consistent: a row may not yet reflect a command that has already returned.

403.description: No declared outcome: the standard refusal for an actor no grant admits: the request was authenticated as no actor, or as one `x-ess-may-read` does not list. It is checked before the view is read, so no row was read, and the same request from a granted actor answers the rows. Its body is the one a command answers an ungranted actor.

actor.description: The qualified name of the actor the request was authenticated as, or null where it was authenticated as none.

refused.description: The standard refusal for an actor no grant admits.

get.description: The overview's figures summed per time bucket of `bucket_seconds` from `since` on, oldest first; buckets without a session are absent.

agenticspec.cli.AutonomyFigures.title: AutonomyFigures
agenticspec.cli.AutonomyFigures.description: Prompts and decisions of main agents. Working is time in which at least one agent of the session was Working (gaps up to 10 minutes). Waiting on the human is time in which no agent was Working, from a main agent's turn end to its next Human or Delegate prompt; over one hour it counts as away.

agenticspec.cli.ConcurrencyFigures.title: ConcurrencyFigures
agenticspec.cli.ConcurrencyFigures.description: Agents active in the same minute; active means two of its records at most 5 minutes apart around the minute.

cost_microdollars.description: The sum of the model figures, at API list price; a subscription bills otherwise.

unpriced_messages.description: Model messages of a model with no price in src/pricing.rs, not in the cost.

cost_microdollars.description: The tokens of these messages at the API list price of the model (src/pricing.rs), in millionths of a dollar; 0 for a model with no price.

model.description: The model of the agent's last turn.

context_tokens.description: The context of the agent's last turn.

agenticspec.view.BucketId.title: BucketId
agenticspec.view.BucketId.description: One time bucket of the overview, its start in milliseconds since the epoch.

agenticspec.view.CountId.title: CountId
agenticspec.view.CountId.description: The count of one event kind in one session, `<session_id>.<agent or *>.<kind>`.

agenticspec.view.EventCount.title: EventCount
agenticspec.view.EventCount.description: How many events of one kind a session holds, of one agent or of all of them: the counts the event log's kind filters show.

agent.description: The agent counted; absent for every agent of the session.

agenticspec.view.EventId.title: EventId
agenticspec.view.EventId.description: One view event of one session, `<session_id>.<seq>`; a dot, since a row key is one segment of an ess-ui node path, which `/` separates.

agenticspec.view.EventRow.title: EventRow
agenticspec.view.EventRow.description: One `agenticspec.view.Event` of a session as a row: the same fields, its time as a `Timestamp`, and the running cost of its agent and of its session.

ord.description: The event's place in its session ordered by `at`, then `seq`, from 0.

notable.description: A prompt, an agent start, a refusal, a failed tool result, a cache bust or a compaction, which the event log shows first.

agent_cost_usd.description: The cost of this event's agent up to and including this event.

session_cost_usd.description: The cost of the session up to and including this event.

agenticspec.view.FigureBucket.title: FigureBucket
agenticspec.view.FigureBucket.description: The sums of the overview's figures over the sessions whose last record falls in one time bucket: a client divides a sum by `sessions` for an average.

agenticspec.view.SessionCheck.title: SessionCheck
agenticspec.view.SessionCheck.description: The verdict of one check of `queries/session.sq` on one session, as `agenticspec query` reports it: the rows the check found, definite and possible.

rows.description: Rows the check's rule found, definite and possible.

possible.description: Rows that hold only under an unknown (an inferred author, a decision not recorded).

agenticspec.view.SessionListing.title: SessionListing
agenticspec.view.SessionListing.description: One session with the figures the overview lists and the session page heads with. The flat figures are derived from `kpis`, so a table can sort and sum them.

project.description: The working directory of the session's first record, relative to the home directory (`~/src/ess`); the projects directory name when no record names one. The UI shows it as the project.

title.description: The harness's title of the session, which it derives from prompt text. It is written only to the local store.

names.description: The project, the title, the model names and the tool names of the session, lower case and space-separated: the text `search` is found in.

rank.description: The session's place by `last_at` among the sessions the store holds, newest 1.

agents.description: Agents of the session, the main agent included.

cost_usd.description: `kpis.cost_microdollars` in dollars: the tokens at API list price.

context_max.description: The largest context of any agent, in tokens.

cache_hit_share.description: Cache read tokens over all input tokens, 0 to 1.

waiting_share.description: The autonomy KPI: `waiting_on_human_seconds` over the session's wall time (`last_at - first_at`), 0 to 1.

kpis.description: The session's own KPI report, as `agenticspec.cli.SessionSummary.kpis`.

agenticspec.view.SlotId.title: SlotId
agenticspec.view.SlotId.description: One time slot of one agent of one session, `<session_id>.<agent>.<start in ms>`.

agenticspec.view.TimelineSlot.title: TimelineSlot
agenticspec.view.TimelineSlot.description: The events of one agent within one time slot of a session, counted by what the timeline draws: tool calls by category, prompts by author, refusals, cache busts and compactions, with the largest context and the running costs at the slot's last event.

slot_seconds.description: The length of the slot; slots start at a multiple of it from the epoch.

start.description: The instant of the slot's first event.

end.description: The instant of the slot's last event.

relayed_prompts.description: Prompts written by a delegate or a peer session.

context_max.description: The largest context of a model turn in the slot.
